integrity: Self-contained proof with exact arm classification and real-variable monotonicity; standalone edge-orientation checker tests all 21844 instances over seven base graphs and exact coefficient/sign identities up to 40 arms. scientific_limitations: Only labelled two-edge-arm spider trees, not general spiders or all trees; exact nonreal-root count but no complex-root location theorem. Small numerical enumeration corroborates, but cannot establish, universal statements; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Parity-rigid real zeros of the acyclic sink polynomial of two-edge spiders
